en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a church with a tall, pointed steeple and a large clock on the front tower. Trees partially obscure the view of the building, and a decorative metal fence is visible in the foreground. The upper left corner of the front side says 'Alnö kyrka' (Swedish for 'Alnö Church'). The back contains handwritten Swedish text, a Swedish 10 öre stamp, and postal markings. It is addressed to a Herr H. J. Kalin in Tälle, Ljusdal.
